title: SVG up to the text limit comes back as markup, a large SVG and a chalkboard's SVG as blob resources the client saves as .svg files
origin: issue #63: PSCAT_MCP_MAX_SVG_BYTES (40 KiB by default) is where SVG switches from a text resource to a blob resource
prompt:
Using the pscat-render tools, make these three calls, then tell me for each one what came back and where the SVG is:

1. render_postscript as an SVG (400×300 points) of this program:
0 0 1 setrgbcolor 50 50 300 200 rectfill

2. render_postscript as an SVG (400×300 points) of this program:
0 1 13000 {dup 37 mul 400 mod exch 53 mul 300 mod 3 3 rectfill} for

3. chalkboard_math with the formula x^2 + y^2 = z^2 as an SVG, width 400 and height 200.
notes: Needs the default server (text limit 40 KiB, output cap 8 MiB). Program 1 is a few hundred bytes of SVG (text, the model sees the markup), program 2 about 1 MB and the 400x200 board about 5 MB (blobs). Claude Code 2.1.322 saves a blob as a .svg file and gives the model the path (docs/LOCAL_TESTING.md section 11). Replaces svg-over-cap (#64), whose 1 MB SVG used to fail with output_too_large.
